messages:
marco: hi team, day 2 here. I need to flip a flag in staging (feature: quick_refund) for an integration smoke. don't have console access yet. who is the fastest person to grant staging toggles?

jaime: welcome @marco! ping infra-oncall for expedited staging grants, or use JIT if you already have the access portal link. quick note: if the flag touches payments you may need approval from payments-owners.

marco: I think it touches a mock payments queue only. how do i confirm whether it's classified as 'payments' in our flag taxonomy?

hannah: flags are namespaced by service in the FF backend. run: `ffctl inspect --flag quick_refund --env staging` and check `service:` field. if it shows `payments` then follow the payments flow.

marco: running that now... got `service: refund-worker (payments)` so i'll loop in payments team.

marco: small extra Q: when I toggle in staging, will it create an audit log visible in the console? we need traceability for the postmortem.

jaime: yes, staging writes audit events to the same audit store, visible under Console -> Admin -> Audit Logs. retention in staging is 30 days by default. production is 90 days.

marco: perfect. do we also need to rotate any keys or anything if the test involves signed webhook calls? concerned about KMS scope for staging creds.

hannah: staging uses a separate KMS keyring `rdw-kms-staging`. You can request access via INFRA-ACCESS and mention `kms:read` only; we rarely grant write to new hires. For signed webhook tests, we usually use the test signing key `webhook-test-key` that doesn't require KMS rotation.

marco: ok filed INFRA-23456 for console + kms.read. also requested payments owner approval. pinged infra-oncall.

infra-oncall: received INFRA-23456, bumping to jaime for approval. If you need temporary toggle-only access I can add `rdw-ff-toggler-staging` for 4h right away. confirm you only need toggle, not role admin.

marco: toggle-only is enough, thanks.

jaime: granting `rdw-ff-toggler-staging` now. Confirm when you see the role in SSO.

devex-bot: Access granted: rdw-ff-toggler-staging to marco. Ticket INFRA-23456 updated.

marco: got it, I can see Feature Flags in Operations. toggled quick_refund -> on for test user. running integration tests now.

marco: tests green. one last thing: where's the recommended rollback note format? want to add to the ticket before I close it.

hannah: short is fine: 1) toggle off via console + tag INFRA, 2) run `refund-smoke --user test-qa`, 3) contact payments oncall if errors > 5% in 1m. paste that into the JIRA.

marco: added rollback steps to INFRA-23456 and closed it. thanks everyone for the quick help! :raised_hands:
